opening.text: My joints hurt and my muscles ache too. They've been going on for 2 weeks. I've been having fevers, I have a rash, and I have a sore throat. I went hiking in North Georgia in March, and I removed a tick from my leg and from my pubic area, three days before my joint pains started. I'm allergic to penicillin; it gives me a bad rash.
